summary: system prompt/instruction/Skill/tool schema/model/effortの変更は一度に一軸だけ行い、変更ごとにablation付きの回帰evalとsoak・段階rolloutで通す。

evidence.summary: Skillあり/なし/一部削除ablationと回帰eval（evidence-supported, high）。GitHubのproduction比較でtask固有instruction再設計後、同品質で約20% cost低下。
Anthropicの再発防止: 'a broad suite of per-model evals for every system prompt change'、拡張ablation、公開buildのdogfooding、system prompt変更へのsoak期間と段階rollout、prompt change review infra。
capability eval（低pass率）とregression eval（ほぼ100%）を分離、graduate運用、owner保守。
MCP serverはtools/list_changed通知でtool schemaを動的変更でき、client側で変更検知が可能。tool schema変化は回帰要因。

optimize-skill (org-private, reputation unknown): read SKILL.md ("1 iterationにつき1つのscoped changeだけ作る", "old/candidateを同一条件で比較する", "gateを通らないcandidateを反映しない") and references/promotion-policy.md, whose gate requires one logical change, identical eval IDs/run configuration, no regression on previously passing cases, and whose automatic-rejection list includes "multiple logical changes" and "hidden regressions"; report-only/branch modes give the staged rollout.

applies_when: model・effort・harnessの更新が外部起因で入る
not_applicable_when: 安全・権限・data保護規則（効率理由のablation削除対象にしない）
evalを回すtoken予算が確保できない小規模変更（→最低限smoke task）

expected_effect.primary: 回帰の原因軸を1つに限定し、検出と巻き戻しを速くする
metrics: 変更あたりの同時変更軸数

risks: 一軸ずつは遅い（→低リスク変更はbatch可とする判断基準が必要）
cost: 回帰suite（代表task 10-30件）の作成・保守とrun費用
known_failure_modes: 複数軸を同時変更しての体感評価（postmortemで3原因が重なり検出困難に）

matched_on: exactly one logical change per iteration
baseline and candidate run under identical eval IDs and shared run configuration
regression gate: no previously passing case may fail and no case score may decrease
staged rollout: report-only by default, then an inspectable branch, never push or merge

evidence: org-private shared plugin in the TechLog shared checkout; not published

alternates.why_not_primary: its evaluation policy supplies the ablation-style test sets (replay/target/holdout/adjacent, trigger-positive/negative) and forbids regression, and revalidate mode covers externally driven model/effort/harness updates, but it does not state the one-axis-per-change rule as directly as optimize-skill's promotion gate.

evidence: org-private shared plugin in the TechLog shared checkout; not published, so there is no public track record to assess

alternates.why_not_primary: requires minimal edit units and running the Skill validator plus trigger/non-trigger prompts after instruction changes, but has no regression eval suite or staged rollout.
